questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Ladoke Akintola University of Technology (LAUTECH) is located in which town?
questions.explanation: LAUTECH's main campus is located in Ogbomoso, a historic Yoruba town in Oyo State.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: LAUTECH was named in honour of which prominent Nigerian political figure?
questions.explanation: The university is named after Chief Samuel Ladoke Akintola, a former Premier of the Western Region of Nigeria.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What position did Chief Ladoke Akintola, the university's namesake, hold in the old Western Region?
questions.explanation: Chief S.L. Akintola served as Premier of the Western Region of Nigeria in the years leading up to the country's first military coup in 1966.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: LAUTECH was originally established as a joint venture between which two state governments before later reforms?
questions.explanation: LAUTECH was founded in 1990 as a jointly owned institution of the old Oyo State, and continued as a joint venture between Oyo and Osun States after Osun's creation in 1991, until later ownership changes.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which Nigerian state is Ogbomoso, the host town of LAUTECH, located in?
questions.explanation: Ogbomoso is one of the largest towns in Oyo State, located in south-western Nigeria.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Ogbomoso is historically notable as an important town within which pre-colonial Yoruba empire's sphere of influence?
questions.explanation: Ogbomoso developed as a significant Yoruba town within the historical sphere of the Old Oyo Empire, one of the most powerful pre-colonial West African states.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the capital city of Oyo State?
questions.explanation: Ibadan is the capital and largest city of Oyo State, and also one of the largest cities in West Africa by population.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What academic focus is LAUTECH primarily known for, as reflected in its name?
questions.explanation: LAUTECH, as its name indicates, was established with a strong focus on technology, engineering, and applied science programmes.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: The Old Oyo Empire, historically linked to the Ogbomoso area, was ruled by a monarch bearing which traditional title?
questions.explanation: The ruler of the Old Oyo Empire held the title of Alaafin, one of the most prestigious traditional titles among the Yoruba.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which regulatory body is responsible for accrediting academic programmes in Nigerian universities, including LAUTECH?
options: The Federal Ministry of Education alone, with no separate agency
The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB)
questions.explanation: The NUC is the regulatory body responsible for approving and accrediting academic programmes offered by Nigerian universities, ensuring they meet minimum quality standards.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary role of a Vice-Chancellor in a Nigerian university, such as LAUTECH?
options: Serving as the elected student union president
Serving as an external auditor of the university's accounts
Managing only the university's sports facilities
Serving as the chief executive and academic head of the university
questions.explanation: A Vice-Chancellor is the chief executive and principal academic officer of a Nigerian university, responsible for its overall administration and academic direction.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which arm of government in Nigeria is primarily responsible for making laws?
questions.explanation: The Legislature (the National Assembly at federal level) is the arm of government responsible for making laws, distinct from the law-interpreting Judiciary and law-enforcing Executive.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following countries shares a land border with Nigeria?
questions.explanation: Nigeria shares land borders with Cameroon, Niger, Chad, and Benin Republic; Ghana, South Africa, and Kenya are not bordering countries.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the longest river in Nigeria?
questions.explanation: The River Niger, after which the country is named, is the longest river in Nigeria and one of the major rivers in West Africa.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary function of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC)?
options: Organising and supervising elections in Nigeria
questions.explanation: INEC is Nigeria's independent body responsible for organising, conducting, and supervising elections at the federal and state levels.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is a major cash crop historically associated with Oyo State and the wider south-western Nigeria region?
questions.explanation: Cocoa has historically been a major cash crop cultivated across south-western Nigeria, including areas within Oyo State, contributing significantly to the region's economy.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for oxygen?
questions.explanation: Oxygen's chemical symbol is simply 'O', as assigned on the periodic table of elements.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars is commonly called the 'Red Planet' due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface, which gives it a reddish appearance.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is Nigeria's national football team commonly nicknamed?
questions.explanation: Nigeria's senior men's national football team is popularly known as the Super Eagles, distinct from Ghana's Black Stars and Cameroon's Indomitable Lions.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which international body is primarily responsible for maintaining international peace and security?
questions.explanation: The UN is the international organisation primarily responsible for maintaining global peace and security, alongside fostering international cooperation.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for a system of government in which power is shared between a central authority and constituent states or regions?
questions.explanation: Federalism is a system of government in which power is constitutionally divided between a central government and constituent states, as practised in Nigeria.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary function of the Nigerian Police Force?
options: Maintaining law and order and enforcing criminal law
questions.explanation: The Nigerian Police Force is the primary law enforcement agency responsible for maintaining public order and enforcing criminal law across the country.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is an example of a non-communicable disease?
questions.explanation: Diabetes is a non-communicable (non-infectious) disease related to the body's regulation of blood sugar, unlike tuberculosis, cholera, and measles, which are infectious.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the largest continent in the world by land area?
questions.explanation: Asia is the largest continent in the world both by land area and by population.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Who is generally credited with leading the Sokoto Jihad in the early 19th century, later founding the Sokoto Caliphate?
questions.explanation: Uthman Dan Fodio led the Sokoto Jihad in the early 19th century, a religious and political reform movement that resulted in the founding of the Sokoto Caliphate.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary role of the executive arm of government?
questions.explanation: The executive arm, headed by a President or Governor, is primarily responsible for implementing and enforcing the laws made by the legislature.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which vitamin deficiency is most commonly associated with the disease rickets in children?
questions.explanation: Rickets, a condition causing weak or soft bones in children, is most commonly associated with a deficiency of Vitamin D.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for the total value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders in a given period?
questions.explanation: GDP specifically measures the value of goods and services produced within a country's borders, regardless of the nationality of the producers.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which Nigerian author wrote the celebrated novel 'Things Fall Apart'?
questions.explanation: Chinua Achebe wrote 'Things Fall Apart' (1958), one of the most widely read and celebrated African novels in modern literary history.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What does the abbreviation 'JAMB' stand for in the Nigerian education context?
questions.explanation: JAMB conducts the Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination (UTME) and coordinates admissions into Nigerian tertiary institutions.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for a persistent, sustained rise in the general price level of goods and services in an economy?
questions.explanation: Inflation describes an ongoing, generalised increase in prices across an economy, reducing the purchasing power of money over time.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following best describes the primary aim of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)?
options: Promoting economic integration and cooperation among West African countries
Coordinating only military alliances in West Africa
Restricting all trade between West African nations
questions.explanation: ECOWAS aims to promote economic integration, free movement of people, and regional cooperation among its West African member states.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: Which of the following is a major indigenous language widely spoken in Oyo State, including in Ogbomoso and Ibadan?
questions.explanation: Yoruba is the predominant indigenous language spoken across Oyo State, including in towns such as Ogbomoso and Ibadan.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.text: What is the term for the legal document that formally establishes the rules and structure of governance for a country?
questions.explanation: A constitution is the fundamental legal document that establishes the framework, powers, and limits of a country's system of governance.
